ValidationRule.description: For General Dealing Enquiry, if Expected Completion Date is < 5 days OR is change, Comments is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordTypeId = '01290000001MHAe', /*General Dealing Enquiry*/
OR ( ISCHANGED(Expected_Completion_Date__c), Expected_Completion_Date__c - TODAY () < 5),
NOT($UserRole.Id = '00E90000001P6KH'),
NOT($User.Id = '00590000004hkhl'),
NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"),
NOT($Profile.Name = "Qantas System Administrator"),
NOT($Profile.Name = "Qantas System Admin - Freight"),
NOT($Profile.Name = "Qantas System Admin - QCC"),
NOT($Profile.Name = "Qantas System Admin - SND"),
ISPICKVAL ( Status , "Not yet assigned - with Account Manager"),
ISBLANK ( Comments__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Standard expected completion date is 6 working days, please state the reasons if you require this request to be fulfilled earlier.
